tasks.subject: Task 1: Add pystac-client dependency
tasks.description:
**Goal:** pystac-client importable in the project's .venv, alongside the existing notebooks group deps (ipykernel).

**Files:**
- Modify: pyproject.toml (repo root)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] pystac-client appears in the notebooks dependency-group in root pyproject.toml
- [ ] uv.lock regenerated, includes pystac-client and transitive deps
- [ ] import pystac_client succeeds in the project's .venv

**Verify:** uv run python -c "import pystac_client; print(pystac_client.__version__)"

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-docs-notebook.md Task 1 for full steps.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["pyproject.toml", "uv.lock"], "verifyCommand": "uv run python -c \"import pystac_client; print(pystac_client.__version__)\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["pystac-client in notebooks group", "uv.lock regenerated", "import succeeds"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Write the demo notebook and link it from the tutorials index
tasks.description:
**Goal:** docs/using-geoquery/tutorials/stac-api-demo.ipynb walking every stac_api endpoint plus a pystac-client interop section, verified to run end-to-end against the live dev server, linked from tutorials/index.md.

**Files:**
- Create: docs/using-geoquery/tutorials/stac-api-demo.ipynb
- Modify: docs/using-geoquery/tutorials/index.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Notebook covers: setup, landing page, conformance, browse collections, get a collection, browse items, get an item, boundary collection's synthetic item, search (no params / bbox GET / equivalent POST), pystac-client interop, closing note
- [ ] Every code cell's logic runs without error against the real running dev server (verified by extracting and running cell bodies as a plain script)
- [ ] tutorials/index.md has a new bullet matching the existing Public API demo bullet's format

**Verify:** the extracted-cells verification script runs to completion with no exceptions and sensible output

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-stac-docs-notebook.md Task 2 for full cell-by-cell content and the exact build/verify scripts.
